mapper.sql: BIN_TO_UUID(p.id) AS problem_id, p.slug, BIN_TO_UUID(v.id) AS version_id, v.version_no, v.code_mode, v.title, v.statement_markdown, v.input_description_markdown, v.output_description_markdown, v.constraints_markdown, v.hint_markdown, v.difficulty, CAST(v.tags_json AS CHAR) AS tags_json, p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM problem p JOIN problem_version v ON v.id = p.current_published_version_id WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(problem_version_id) AS version_id, ordinal, input_text, expected_output_text, explanation_markdown FROM problem_sample WHERE problem_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) ORDER BY ordinal ASC

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(problem_version_id) AS version_id, language_id, display_order, starter_code FROM problem_version_language WHERE problem_version_id IN
UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId})
ORDER BY problem_version_id, display_order ASC
